about: The epistola of the formulary “19th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Brethren: Be renewed in the spirit of your mind, and put on the new man, who has been created according to God in justice and holiness of truth. For this reason, putting away lying, let each of you speak the truth with his neighbor, for we are members of one another. Be angry, yet do not sin; let the sun not go down on your anger. Do not make room for the devil. Whoever used to steal, let him steal no longer; but rather let him labor, working with his own hands at what is good, so that he may have something to give to a person in need.
